m14.text: Pip, Relno's beloved orange-striped cat, goes with Zurbit when he discovers the tower ransacked by merfolk, and they row to the merfolk reef together to drop a message in a flask.
Zurbit gives Pip a green potion and pushes him out over the reef as the cat grows to the size of a small whale.
When Relno returns to find the tower in disarray, Zurbit claims he was just letting in some sea air.
